Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The agent failed to correctly identify the metro station closest to Fire Station 301 DCA ARFF. It incorrectly assumed the destination was served by the Reagan National Airport station (Blue/Yellow Line), whereas Fire Station 301 is actually located near the **L'Enfant Plaza** station (Yellow/Orange/Silver Lines). This initial factual error regarding the destination station led to the subsequent incorrect identification of the starting station (Cleveland Park) and the false conclusion that no direct route exists.
